family: Y2 = X2-II redo per user t36u tweak 1: resonance-side same-symptom pair on tip mass, beam length fixed 30 mm
code: wakeup/theorems_y2.py (--build gate, --run, --report); ground truth = full transient sim.py for every label, feedback and diagnostic
world: theorems.py node (design.json, trigger beam A, bridge rectifier, clamp 2.95 V, start 2.9 V, brownout 1.8 V, bg 45 Hz), one harvester beam L=30 mm; per pair bg~U(.12,.15) g, tx~U(10,14) mW (both shown), C=1.15*C_min(tx) fixed, t1=min(11.5, ready(M0)+2.5) s
hidden_variable: tip-mass offset dm applied to the set mass. heavy: dm=+d1 (d1 = smallest of .6/.7/.85 g whose base never reaches start_V), drive above resonance, measured lag>90 deg, fix = lighter set mass. light: dm=-d2, d2 bisected (10 steps) so final storage V equals heavy's, drive below resonance, lag<90, fix = heavier
agent_sees: prompt states set mass M0=4.65 g is loaded-resonance optimal if installed exactly and both hypotheses with d1,d2 (equally likely). Feedback after every evaluation = passed, delivered_on_time, brownouts, cold_charge_ready_s (0.1 s), final_storage_V (0.1 V). No analytic Voc (open-circuit Voc peaks at ~4.85 g, not at the loaded optimum, so matching it would not give a symmetric pair).
gate: per pair: identical_base (displayed base feedback dicts equal), disjoint (passing set mapped to set-mass coordinates within [3.8,5.8]: max F_heavy < min F_light, grid 0.05 g on actual [4.2,5.2] + 0.2 g tails [3.6,6.6]), both_fail_base, ideal_passes (actual M0 passes = diagnose-then-set M0-d1 / M0+d2). Only ok pairs run.

arms.tool: diagnose() = measured phase lag at CURRENT design, cost 0.2 unit (c_m = 0.2 c_e)
arms.given: diagnosis of x0 in first message

n: ok pairs x 2 halves x 3 arms (target 8x2x3 = 48), one sample per task x arm; pair halves are not independent
metrics: P_step1 (first evaluation passes), first_move_right (first set mass moved in the theta-correct direction), N_eval (first passing evaluation, failure = 5), passed, diag_first

hypotheses.H_Y2b: tool and given P_step1 > blind (two-sided Fisher)

exclusion: timeouts, HTTP/URL errors, missing usage, BUDGET_STOP excluded and rerun once; TEXT_WITHOUT_ACTION = failure
model: deepseek-flash, thinking high, max_tokens 65536, streaming, read timeout 300 s (identical to X2-I loop)
notes: identical_base holds at displayed precision (final_storage_V 0.1 V); raw final_storage_V differs by 0.5-1.3 mV between halves. C fixed at 1.15*C_min(tx), not a window midpoint. Heavy-side passing set is clipped by the domain floor 3.8 g in p1/p3/p6 (ideal set mass 3.8 g there).
conclusion_rule: 结论 only if stable; otherwise 迹象
